mapper.select: SELECT encode(h.id, 'hex') AS "id", h.spu_id AS "spuId", encode(h.sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId", s.sku_code AS "skuCode", s.sku_name AS "skuName", s.stock_quantity AS "skuStockQuantity", s.status AS "skuStatus", h.stock_quantity AS "stockQuantity", h.remaining_quantity AS "remainingQuantity", h.status AS "status", h.start_at AS "startAt", h.end_at AS "endAt", h.version AS "version", h.created_at AS "createdAt", h.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM product_hot_sku h INNER JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = h.sku_id WHERE h.spu_id = #{spuId} ORDER BY h.updated_at DESC, h.created_at DESC

WITH target_spu AS ( SELECT id FROM product_spu WHERE id = #{spuId} ), incoming AS ( SELECT raw.sku_id AS sku_id, raw.sku_id_bytes_hex AS sku_id_bytes_hex, raw.hot_id_bytes_hex AS hot_id_bytes_hex, raw.stock_quantity AS stock_quantity, raw.status AS status, raw.start_at_epoch_ms AS start_at_epoch_ms, raw.end_at_epoch_ms AS end_at_epoch_ms FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( sku_id text, sku_id_bytes_hex text, hot_id_bytes_hex text, stock_quantity integer, status text, start_at_epoch_ms bigint, end_at_epoch_ms bigint ) ), normalized AS ( SELECT sku_id, decode(sku_id_bytes_hex, 'hex') AS sku_id_bytes, decode(hot_id_bytes_hex, 'hex') AS hot_id_bytes, stock_quantity, status, CASE WHEN start_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(start_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END AS start_at, CASE WHEN end_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(end_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END AS end_at FROM incoming ), target_sku AS ( SELECT n.*, s.stock_quantity AS db_stock_quantity, s.status AS sku_status FROM normalized n LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.spu_id = #{spuId} AND s.id = n.sku_id_bytes ), stats AS ( SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target_spu) AS spu_exists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normalized) AS requested_count, COUNT(db_stock_quantity) AS matched_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE db_stock_quantity IS NOT NULL AND sku_status != 'ACTIVE') AS inactive_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE db_stock_quantity IS NOT NULL AND (stock_quantity IS NULL OR stock_quantity <= 0 OR stock_quantity > db_stock_quantity) ) AS stock_invalid_count FROM target_sku ), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO product_hot_sku ( id, spu_id, sku_id, stock_quantity, remaining_quantity, status, start_at, end_at ) SELECT t.hot_id_bytes, #{spuId}, t.sku_id_bytes, t.stock_quantity, t.stock_quantity, t.status, t.start_at, t.end_at FROM target_sku t CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE st.spu_exists = true AND st.requested_count = st.matched_count AND st.inactive_count = 0 AND st.stock_invalid_count = 0 ON CONFLICT (sku_id) DO UPDATE SET stock_quantity = EXCLUDED.stock_quantity, remaining_quantity = EXCLUDED.remaining_quantity, status = EXCLUDED.status, start_at = EXCLUDED.start_at, end_at = EXCLUDED.end_at, version = product_hot_sku.version + 1, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING sku_id, stock_quantity, remaining_quantity, status, start_at, end_at, version ) SELECT (SELECT spu_exists FROM stats) AS "spuExists", (SELECT requested_count FROM stats) AS "requestedCount", (SELECT matched_count FROM stats) AS "matchedCount", (SELECT inactive_count FROM stats) AS "inactiveCount", (SELECT stock_invalid_count FROM stats) AS "stockInvalidCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted) AS "affectedCount", COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'skuId', encode(sku_id, 'hex'), 'stockQuantity', stock_quantity, 'remainingQuantity', remaining_quantity, 'status', status, 'startAtEpochMs', FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM start_at) * 1000)::bigint, 'endAtEpochMs', FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_at) * 1000)::bigint, 'version', version ) ) FROM upserted ), '[]'::jsonb)::text AS "redisItemsJson"
